name: Marketing agencies & coaches
summary: Lanternfield Automation implements custom AI automations for small marketing agencies and coaching businesses in the DACH region and English-speaking Europe: client reporting, lead follow-up, onboarding, content operations. Retainers start at about EUR 3,000 per month, so the buyer needs steady client revenue.

industries.marketing_agency: A marketing, performance, paid-social, SEO, content or social-media agency that runs campaigns for several client accounts
industries.coaching_business: A coach, consultant or online-course business selling programmes to clients or cohorts (business, fitness, mindset, career coaching)
industries.creative_studio: A design, branding, video or web studio delivering creative projects for clients
industries.agency_adjacent_service: A service business with recurring client accounts that behaves like an agency: PR firms, recruiting boutiques, fractional-CMO collectives, lead-gen shops

revenue_band_labels.under_10k: under EUR 10k per month (under ~EUR 120k a year)
revenue_band_labels.10k_30k: EUR 10k to 30k per month (~EUR 120k to 360k a year)
revenue_band_labels.30k_100k: EUR 30k to 100k per month (~EUR 360k to 1.2M a year)
revenue_band_labels.over_100k: over EUR 100k per month (over ~EUR 1.2M a year)

geography: Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the Netherlands, the Nordics, the UK and Ireland; remote-first teams anywhere in Europe are fine

founder_owner.description: Founder, owner, CEO or managing director of the agency or coaching business

head_of_operations.description: COO, head of operations, operations manager or chief of staff who owns internal processes and tooling

head_of_delivery.description: Head of client services, account director, delivery lead or head of client success who owns client work and reporting

marketing_lead.description: Head of marketing, growth lead or marketing manager inside the company

manual_reporting.description: Building client reports, dashboards or monthly decks by hand; time lost pulling numbers together for clients

scaling_with_freelancers.description: Delivery depends on freelancers or a stretched team; quality or capacity breaks when more clients come in; briefing and handovers eat time

lead_followup.description: Inbound leads or replies are answered late or not at all; follow-up, qualification or nurturing falls through the cracks

onboarding_chaos.description: New clients or members are onboarded manually: forms, contracts, kick-off documents, account setup done by hand and inconsistently

content_bottleneck.description: Producing, repurposing or scheduling content for clients or the business itself is the bottleneck

disqualifiers.too_small_or_pre_revenue: The company is a hobby, side project, pre-revenue idea, or explicitly says it has no or very few paying clients or a very tight budget
disqualifiers.enterprise: A large corporation or enterprise (hundreds or thousands of employees, corporate group, listed company, public sector)
disqualifiers.competitor: The company itself builds or sells AI automation, AI agents, automation consulting or no-code implementation services to agencies or SMEs
disqualifiers.student_or_academic: The sender is a student, researcher, journalist or job seeker asking for an interview, thesis input, internship, or a job

intent_signals: asks for a call, demo or proposal
states a timeline (this month, this quarter, before a launch)
mentions a budget or an approved spend
describes a concrete process they want automated
recent news: new funding, hiring, new clients, expansion

hot.label: Founder call
hot.action: Offer two 30-minute slots this week; founder takes the call

warm.label: SDR sequence A
warm.action: Personalised 3-step sequence with the matching case study; goal: qualifying call

nurture.label: Nurture track
nurture.action: Newsletter plus the content track for their industry; re-score on the next reply

disqualify.label: Polite decline
disqualify.action: Decline template drafted for a human to glance at; never auto-sent

existing.label: Account owner
existing.action: Hand to the account owner with the message attached; no new outreach
